entities.summary: Anunwa "Nuni" Omot is a South Sudanese-American professional basketball player who last played for the Magnolia Chicken Timplados Hotshots of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA). He played college basketball for the Baylor Bears after two years at Concordia University and Indian Hills Community College.
